{{Top}}
[[File:MN-2E-EGD.jpg|thumb|right|The [[MN-2E general maintenance droid]] was equipped with four manipulator arms.]]
A '''manipulator arm''' was a type of robotic [[Limb/Legends|limb]] that was used for [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and factory hardware. It was used to manipulate objects. Some [[Mining station/Legends|mining stations]] were equipped with manipulator arms, allowing the miners aboard to acquire asteroids and other space material for [[Mining/Legends|mining]].
